items.source: Alternative to classes() to specify the classes as class names.
items.translation: 作为classes()的替代方案，可将类指定为类名。

items.source: Specify the member categories to enable.
items.translation: 指定要启用的成员类别。

items.source: If the class is not available, classNames() allows to specify the fully qualified name, rather than the Class reference.
items.translation: 如果类不可用，classNames() 允许指定完全限定名，而不是 Class 引用。

items.source: If scanning of Reflective is enabled, any type in the configured packages can use this annotation as well.
items.translation: 如果启用了 `Reflective` 的扫描，则配置的任何包中的类型也可以使用此注解。

items.source: The annotated element can also be any test class that uses the Spring TestContext Framework to load an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 注释的元素也可以是任何使用Spring TestContext 框架加载ApplicationContext的测试类。

items.source: When using this annotation directly, only the defined member categories are registered for each target class. The target classes can be specified by class or class names. When both are specified, they are all considered. If no target class is specified, the current class is used.
items.translation: 当直接使用此注解时，仅为目标类注册已定义的成员类别。目标类可以通过类或类名指定。如果同时指定两者，则全部予以考虑。如果未指定目标类，则使用当前类。

items.source:
This annotation can be used as a meta-annotation to customize how hints
are registered against each target class.
items.translation: 此注解可用作元注解，以自定义如何针对每个目标类注册提示。

items.source: You can use this annotation on any bean that is contributed to the context:
items.translation: 您可以在贡献到上下文的任何 Bean 上使用此注解：

items.source:
To register reflection hints for the type itself, only member categories
should be specified:
items.translation: 要为类型本身注册反射提示，仅应指定成员类别：

items.source:
Reflection hints can be registered from a method. In this case, at least
one target class should be specified:
items.translation: 反射提示可以从一个方法注册。在这种情况下，应至少指定一个目标类：

items.source:
By default, the annotated type is the target of the registration. When
placed on a method, at least one class must be specified.
items.translation: 默认情况下，注解类型是注册的目标。当注解放置在方法上时，必须至少指定一个类。

items.source: Classes for which reflection hints should be registered.
